pavithragent.description: Main orchestrator. Deep file reader + thread deep leader. Spawns subagents 1-10 for parallel fan-out.

pavithragent_1.description: Deep-Read Specialist. Reads files/folders in-depth with full content analysis.

pavithragent_2.description: Thread-Analysis Specialist. Analyzes Reddit threads and online discussions.

pavithragent_3.description: Summary Specialist. Generates comprehensive folder/project summaries.

pavithragent_4.description: Search Specialist. Searches files for keywords with context extraction.

pavithragent_5.description: Analysis Specialist. Deep analysis with architecture review and pattern detection.

pavithragent_6.description: Verification Specialist (Adversary). Cross-checks outputs with 5 adversarial checks.

pavithragent_7.description: Security-Audit Specialist. Finds vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, risky patterns.

pavithragent_8.description: Cross-Reference Specialist. Finds imports, includes, function calls, dependencies.

pavithragent_9.description: Error-Recovery Specialist. Repairs failed outputs and re-verifies.

pavithragent_10.description: Conclusion Aggregator. Collects all outputs and generates final consolidated report.

jawis.description: Fast automation and scripting agent. Python batch scrape generate parse.
